decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1/ The proposed  single storey flank and rear extension would, by reason  of its  size  position and appearance including a lack of setback from the main frontage of the house be detrimental to the visual amenities of the area and serve to infringe the privacy of the neighbouring property.    The development is not in accordance with Policies  ENVB 1.1 (New Development)   and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations) of the  Unitary Development Plan, (2003) and Supplementary Planning Guidance, House Extension Guidelines.     
2/ The proposed  single storey flank and rear extension  would lead to  the loss of a parking space and encourage on street parking, creating conditions prejudicial to the free flow of traffic The development is not in accordance with Policies  ENVB 1.1 (New Development)   and T 1.4 (Car and cycle parking and servicing facilities for developments) of the  Unitary Development Plan, (2003).
description: Erection of a single storey side and rear extension to existing house
